title: fields: a read-only `NumberField` renders the raw stored value — a field declaring `scale: 2` shows `1234.5` in a read-only form while its table cell shows `1,234.50`
body: Filing-gate category: ① a product defect, class (b), declared and not delivered. `reach:` public door, measured: a form field `{ type: 'number', readonly: true, scale: 2 }` holding a stored `1234.5` renders `1234.5` through the real `SchemaRenderer`, form renderer and `@object-ui/fields` registration, the same as with no `scale`; `NumberCellRenderer` renders the same field `1,234.50`. Reader who acts: triage first (grade, route), then the `domain:ui` seat that dispatches it. Filed by `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_01YLg8XqWGJ785fwQ5v4pH37`) from the os-dev report on objectstack-ai/objectui#11413 (PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11429, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`; a temporary probe, deleted). ⛔ Not graded here. ## The defect (objectui `origin/main`) - `packages/fields/src/widgets/NumberField.tsx:16`–`:18` (seat re-read): `if (readonly) { return value == null ? : {value}; }`. The read-only face prints the raw value: no width, no grouping, no display locale. - The contract: `@objectstack/spec`'s `scale` description says consumers resolve the effective width by calling `resolveFieldScale` from `@objectstack/spec/data`, and objectui's `NumberFieldMetadata.scale` documents it as "Number of decimal places to display". Ruling A′ (objectstack-ai/objectstack#19628) put every number face on that resolver; `NumberCellRenderer` and the gantt tooltip moved in PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11412 (objectui#11254). - Seen before and recorded, not filed: PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11089's relay census lists "the read-only `NumberField` renders the raw value" as "not a copy" of the grouping relay; nothing tracks it. ## Direction (for triage, not a ruling) The read-only face renders through the same formatter the cell uses (`formatDisplayNumber` with the width from `resolveFieldScale` and the field's grouping policy), so the form and the table agree by construction. Pin: a read-only `scale: 2` field shows `1,234.50`, and an undeclared one shows natural precision. ## Dedupe The 817 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs, open and closed (REST, grepped locally 2026-10-02): "NumberField … read-only" 2 (PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11429, the report that found it; PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11089, the census line quoted above); "read-only … number … scale/decimal" 2 (PR #11429, and PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11246 about the percent widget's read-only face, already on the resolver); control `NumberCellRenderer` 7.
